name: The Goredening
source:
You were buried alive. It’s up to you to decide whether you’ll try to get out.

But if you do… be ready for whatever comes next.

[From [url=https://iamdoktor.itch.io/the-goredening]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被活埋了。要不要试着逃出去，由你决定。

可你如果真这么做了…就要准备好面对接下来的一切。

［摘自[url=https://iamdoktor.itch.io/the-goredening]Itch.io[/url]］
